Class MatchScoreController

java.lang.Object
com.ex.tennistournament.controller.MatchScoreController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/match-scores") public class MatchScoreController extends Object
REST Controller for managing match scores. Handles all score-related operations for tennis matches.
